choices.reason: The introduction reports the creativity contrast between personalized and generic AI, and Methods explicitly describes partial personalization as a robustness test. Both candidates measure full-sample campaign theme diversity, so rule 2 favors the main personalized contrast.
choices.locator: PDF p. 5, Introduction, second paragraph; PDF p. 22, Experimental Design, first paragraph.
choices.quote: We find evidence of significant synergy, such that humans collaborating with personalized AI produce more creative campaigns compared to AI alone or participants who work with a generic tool.
